headlines.title: Apple announces long-awaited foldable phone, iPhone Duo
headlines.description: Apple’s first foldable phone capped a day of product announcements that also included the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

headlines.title: ‘South Park’ is now ‘South America’ in dig at Apple and Google for observing Trump’s Lake Ontario order
headlines.description: “South Park” creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone renamed their show “South America” in a not-so-subtle dig at Trump, big tech and the pair’s own corporate bosses.

headlines.title: China hits back at U.S. claim its AI companies systematically copied American models
headlines.description: In its most detailed accusation yet, the U.S. government has named six Chinese AI companies that it says copied American companies for their AI secrets.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Rhode Island primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Rhode Island, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Sen. John Fetterman makes a surprise cameo praising Republicans at the GOP convention
headlines.description: The Democratic senator appeared on video promoting the efforts of President Donald Trump and Sen. Dave McCormick in shaping the U.S. Steel deal with Nippon Steel.

headlines.title: AI researcher says there is 'substantial probability' AI could kill all humans in next decade
headlines.description: Former AI researcher for Anthropic and Open AI, Jacob Coxon, talked to NBC News' Tom Llamas about his viral tweet where he stated AI could "kill us all" by the end of the next decade. Coxon spoke about why he resigned from Anthropic, how AI advancements are creating major concerns and what could be done about it.

headlines.title: Critics say ‘fashion slop’ is coming for the industry’s design creativity
headlines.description: As social media makes trends move faster than ever, some fashion brands are leaning into A.I. and algorithms to churn out more clothes some are calling "slop." NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Apple unveils foldable iPhone
headlines.description: NBC News’ Savannah Sellers reports from Cupertino, CA where Apple’s new CEO debuted the company’s first foldable iPhone. Savannah was one of the first people to get a chance to try out the new device.

headlines.title: Dire warning that A.I. could end humanity
headlines.description: A researcher from a top artificial intelligence lab resigned and posted to social media saying that there are those who work in A.I. who believe their very creations could kill all of mankind within a decade. NBC News’ Chief Business Correspondent Christine Romans reports.

headlines.title: Apple announces first foldable iPhone at annual event
headlines.description: In his first event as Apple CEO, John Ternus announced the first foldable iPhone, marking the biggest change to the iPhone since it was introduced in 2007. Apple said the iPhone Duo would sell for a base price of $1,999. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Tech company discloses first-of-its-kind A.I. cyberattack of one government against another
headlines.description: Israeli cyber security firm Dream says it disclosed an A.I. hack working to compromise a government entity in Asia, thousands of miles away. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Best Apps to Simplify the Back-to-School Routine
headlines.description: As families are settling into the school year, a little tech can go a long way toward making that return to busy days a little more manageable. Tech expert Katie Linendoll joins TODAY with her favorite apps to help you get back in the swing of things, including SuperAlarm that puts you on a mission to complete tasks to stop the alarm, Libby, a free digital reading app, and more!
